arguments: Avoid temporary parameter-key arrays during SSR fragment wrapping

Enumerate the private parameter snapshot directly while retaining existing-value fragment wrapping. Add three owning-renderer preservation rows for Server, WebAssembly and Auto. Three closed AB/BA/AB comparisons save 56 B/op in the one-scalar fresh-boundary primary, but do not establish a latency gain: its median paired less-time effect is -1.43%, with slower means in two pairs. Publish as an allocation trade-off, retaining the unstable first baseline, adverse results and unchanged controls; no application-throughput or merge-ready claim.
